Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 18-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  BIO-INFORMATICS [CSE_4012]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                                                                  Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Apply the concept of bioinformatics to demonstrate its scope.                                                                                        (5)  
  
  
  A)                                                                                                       Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Analyse the 5 steps involved in the BLAST approach.                                                                                                  (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2)                Apply the concept of tandem repeats (like VNTRs) and state how the dot plot will look when the sequence is plotted against itself.                   (5)  
  
  
  A)                                                                                                       Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Apply the concept of iterative alignment and along with a diagram state the process involved in PRRN, the double nested iteration process.           (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)                Apply the concept of profiles & HMMs in analyzing the steps in the construction of Position-Specific Scoring Matrices (PSSMs).                       (5)  
  
  
  A)                                                                                                       Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Consider two DNA sequences have been aligned, and the following proportions of nucleotide substitutions are observed: proportion of transitions = (5)  
  0.12, proportion of transversions = 0.08. Using the Kimura Two-Parameter model, evaluate the evolutionary distance d AB between the sequences.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"  
  
4)                Assess the computational complexity of Quartet puzzling heuristic methodology by showing a schematic illustration of quartet puzzling in deriving a (5)  
  consensus tree by combining multiple quartet trees.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"  
  
  B)           Analyze the steps for implementing Monte Carlo algorithm to escape local minima.                                                                     (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
5)                Analyze the steps involved in homology modelling for predicting the structure of a target protein.                                                   (5)  
  
  
  A)                                                                                                         Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)                                                                                                                                                                      (5)  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"
